blockingIssues.description: Full chunk excerpts are inserted into planner/answer prompts without untrusted-evidence delimiters or delimiter escaping, so indexed prompt-injection text can still steer ai-search behavior.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Route all planner/answer evidence through the hardened delimiter-wrapped formatter and escape delimiter-like tokens before interpolation.

blockingIssues.description: `citations[].quote` is emitted from the display snippet rather than a verified excerpt substring, so exported quotes are not reliably groundable/verbatim.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Populate quote from a validated verbatim excerpt slice (or drop quote and rely on excerpt/offset fields) so citations remain executable and auditable.

blockingIssues.description: The answer schema rejects numeric citation entries (e.g. `citations: [1]`) before normalization/repair runs, so valid model outputs can fail citation validation.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Accept numeric citation entries in schema parsing and normalize them to evidenceId objects before repair/validation.

blockingIssues.description: Repo-scoped validation droids still pin `custom:GPT-5.4-mini-[cch]-2`, which depends on personal local model configuration and does not robustly remove model-id portability failures.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Switch validation droids to Task-portable model IDs (or add a deterministic fallback strategy) and verify reviewer launches in an environment without personal custom-model mappings.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a mission-level rule that project validation droids must use Task-portable model IDs; avoid environment-specific `custom:*` IDs unless setup + fallback are explicitly codified.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-1 scrutiny was blocked by invalid custom model IDs; round-2 fix still used a personal custom model ID and failed portability review.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require verified commit traceability in handoffs (existing SHA check plus optional commit list per worker session) so reviewers can deterministically replay feature diffs.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: One ai-search handoff contained a non-existent full SHA, and another recorded only a follow-up commit while omitting the earlier implementation commit from the same session.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Refine strict test-first wording to allow tiny pre-test wiring extraction when necessary, while still requiring immediate regression tests before finalization.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The ai-search config feature passed review but logged a justified skill deviation because strict test-first was impractical for an initial CLI/config wiring split.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit instructions for repo-scoped droid/model override tasks, including how to choose portable model IDs and validate Task launches in a clean environment.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The scrutiny model-id fix required ad-hoc probing of personal settings and still landed on an environment-specific custom model ID.

rejectedObservations.observation: Document ai-search prompt-hardening invariants in .factory/library immediately.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected: useful but non-blocking for this scrutiny gate; invariants are already enforced by source + tests and can be documented in a separate follow-up.

rejectedObservations.observation: Treat one worker's `followedProcedure=true` mismatch as a standalone blocker.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected: captured as a process-quality signal, but insufficient evidence for an additional blocking issue independent of the concrete code defects already reported.
